# Offline rendering libraries

The dashboard serves these browser bundles locally so that workflow artifacts
can be read without a network connection or additional project dependencies.

- `markdown-it.min.js`: markdown-it 15.0.3, MIT, from the npm distribution's `dist/browser/markdown-it.umd.min.js`.
- `mermaid.min.js`: Mermaid 11.17.2, MIT, from the npm distribution's `dist/mermaid.min.js`.

The corresponding upstream license files are included in this directory.
